summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI verification passed: after logging in as cathy@example.com, the Profile item is discoverable under the Today sidebar group with an icon and href /app/me; clicking it redirects to Dorothy's primary participant profile at /app/participants/0c538637-b0dd-4982-8f78-b32814c6a5eb. The ParticipantSwitcher dropdown also exposes data-testid participant-switcher-view-profile and navigates to the active participant profile. The CORE-1 profile rendered all required sections, lifetime cap $137,917, and populated statement/invoice/letter/price-check/contribution artefact cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviewed Layout.jsx and ParticipantSwitcher.jsx changes. Layout renders nav-profile unconditionally for authenticated app sidebar/mobile drawer, so the Profile path remains available even if ParticipantSwitcher is collapsed for a one-participant household.
Console log only showed aborted /cdn-cgi/rum requests; no app error messages were found during the verified flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The exact discoverability bug was verified through real UI flows on https://mobile-exact-parity.preview.emergentagent.com using cathy@example.com / testpass123. Automated run confirmed nav-profile under Today, /app/me redirect, ParticipantSwitcher profile link, and full CORE-1 profile rendering. Header title uses preferred_name ('Mum’s profile') while URL/topbar confirm Dorothy's primary participant id.
rca_of_the_issue: Original symptom was caused by routes existing without a visible navigation entry. The fix adds a Today > Profile sidebar link to /app/me and a ParticipantSwitcher menu link to /app/participants/<active_id>; both paths now work end to end. Test plan covered: inspect credentials/git/code changes, verify sidebar discovery without URL typing, verify /app/me primary redirect, verify switcher discovery path, verify required profile sections/cards and key financial value, and code-review the single-participant collapsed switcher edge.
